title: Align ADR 0001's vault_busy claim with the scoped catalog string
description: Found by the independent review of WCLI-27 (opum-ai/ward-cli#51). docs/adr/0001-vault-storage-and-key-custody.md:178-179 records: "Concurrent Ward processes wait for the lock. Past the busy timeout they report vault_busy, and nothing is changed." That is the same unqualified formulation DEC-10 measured false in two paths -- ward init writes the project files before it registers the checkout, and ward restore stores the key before it creates the vault -- and WCLI-27 narrowed only the catalog's copy of it. Read at vault-store level the sentence agrees with the new string, which is true because the mutation transaction rolls back; read at run level it asserts the thing the change exists to stop asserting. It is live either way for a later reader, and the WCLI-15 acceptance matrix is the kind of place that would cite it. Approved by opum-agent as execution of DEC-10, not as new design: the edit reuses the already-approved phrase verbatim and adds no new wording beyond marking the correction, which the fleet requires of a repaired claim so a silent repair teaches nobody.

acceptanceCriteria.text: docs/adr/0001-vault-storage-and-key-custody.md no longer asserts an unqualified nothing-was-changed claim for vault_busy: the sentence is scoped to the vault, the correction is marked with what it was and why, and lore check --strict exits 0

finalSummary:
WCLI-32 delivered on its own small PR (branch docs/WCLI-32-scope-adr-0001-vault-busy-claim). One prose edit, no code.

WHAT CHANGED. docs/adr/0001-vault-storage-and-key-custody.md, in the Consequences list: "Past the busy timeout they report `vault_busy`, and nothing is changed" becomes "... and the vault is not changed", with the correction marked in place — the sentence records that it read "and nothing is changed" until WCLI-27 scoped it, names the two paths DEC-10 measured it false in (ward init writes the project files before it registers the checkout; ward restore stores the key before it creates the vault), and states why the scoped form is the one the record can carry: the mutation runs in one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction, so the rollback is a claim about the vault and not about the run. Marked rather than silently repaired, per the rule that a silent repair teaches nobody.

WHY IT IS EXECUTION OF DEC-10 AND NOT NEW DESIGN. DEC-10 approved exactly two catalog strings and scoped itself to them; this edit changes no catalog string. It reuses the already-approved phrase ("the vault is not changed") verbatim in the one other place the broad claim was still asserted, which is what makes the design record agree with the accepted decision rather than diverge from it. Opum-agent approved it on exactly that basis.

EVIDENCE. The file is plain prose with no lore-managed region in it (checked: no begin/end markers anywhere under docs/), so this is authoring outside a managed region, which is the path lore's own instructions prescribe. lore check --strict exit 0 (11 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 out-of-bundle links skipped); lore validate --strict exit 0 (11 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, 2 skipped); lore agents --check exit 0, CLAUDE.md up to date; node scripts/check-lore-agent-sources.mjs exit 0 (9 concepts, 4 profiles, 0 excluded, 0 concepts in no profile, 0 packs truncated). All four run locally before the PR opened, and all four are steps of the Docs job. No code changed, so the Check job's suite is unaffected.

ALSO IN THIS PR. WCLI-31 (the setup_in_progress finding WCLI-27's review forced) is filed here rather than in a PR of its own, following the same precedent as WCLI-30 riding WCLI-8's handoff PR. It is a tracker record only and carries no code.
